config.inference_estimand: linear conditional-mean regression coefficient, not the finite-sample Sen statistic
config.scope: diagnosis; no grid/cache selection based on best result, no NASA fitting, no release

acceptance_unchanged.note: Approximate nominal targets plus prior minimum screens; not automatic release. No post-result tuning.

accounting: Within a panel scenarios and grids/caches are paired; fixed-panel cache variation is conditional on records. Fresh panel/cache pairs are independent across cache IDs; cluster-t intervals use eight units, not pooled Bernoulli trials.
